title: Thanks generative AI!!!
author: Roguelike-Engine103
selftext: You helped me make six variations for 70 classic r/21stCenturyHack monsters. Now David’s Treasure Zoo looks even cooler than in 1985!!!

comments.author: TheKaleKing
comments.body: Wow that is really cool, well done! Which AI did you use for that? Also, did you do anything special for them to all fit in the same art style? They fit all pretty well together, good job!

replies.author: Roguelike-Engine103
replies.body: Thank you for the kind words, all the art was done with Adobe Firefly using a basic subscription and then reworked manually in GIMP. In many cases I had to feed very carefully constructed outlines into the composition reference for Adobe Firefly and regenerate endlessly ... but I still think there are some inconsistencies throughout the body of the art, and I asked the community for additional pointers in getting the paper dolls more consistent.
